tweets.title: Surprisingly, tadpoles (& axolotls) appear to be far less sensitive to O₂ than mice (& humans), consistent with reduced HIF1A regulation. They maintain
tweets.body: Surprisingly, tadpoles (& axolotls) appear to be far less sensitive to O₂ than mice (& humans), consistent with reduced HIF1A regulation. They maintain regenerative responses even under oxygen conditions that suppress regeneration in mouse limbs—even at high (60%) O₂ levels!🤯
